hero_claim.headline_en: Exosome Synergy: Advanced Regeneration for Youthful Skin
hero_claim.headline_kr: 엑소좀 시너지: 젊고 건강한 피부를 위한 혁신적인 리뉴얼
hero_claim.scientific_basis_en: Exosomes, rich in bioactive molecules, are known for their regenerative properties. Combined with Hyaluronic Acid, which provides essential hydration and plumps the skin, and other synergistic ingredients, this complex supports skin barrier function, aids in post-procedure recovery, and contributes to a more youthful appearance. Research highlights the role of exosomes in cellular communication and tissue repair, while Hyaluronic Acid is fundamental for maintaining skin hydration and elasticity. (PMID: 42059240, 42169069, 42219094, 42382896)

tech_story.headline_en: Harnessing Exosome Bio-signals for Advanced Skin Regeneration
tech_story.headline_kr: 첨단 피부 재생을 위한 엑소좀 바이오 시그널 활용
supporting_facts_en: Exosomes are key mediators of intercellular communication, delivering growth factors and other bioactive molecules.
Our formulation leverages the synergistic power of exosomes with essential skin nutrients like Hyaluronic Acid.
Advanced delivery systems ensure optimal penetration and efficacy.
supporting_facts_kr: 엑소좀은 성장 인자 및 기타 생리활성 물질을 전달하는 세포 간 소통의 핵심 매개체입니다.
본 포뮬러는 엑소좀과 히알루론산과 같은 필수 피부 영양소의 시너지 효과를 활용합니다.
첨단 전달 시스템은 최적의 침투력과 효능을 보장합니다.
